gate-prompt:a1-arrival.en: Voss talks too fast. Ask him to say it again.
gate-prompt:a1-arrival.tr: Voss çok hızlı konuşuyor. Ondan tekrar söylemesini iste.

objective:a1-arrival:1.en: Read the ticket and the departure board

objective:a1-arrival:2.en: Voss talks too fast. Ask him to say it again.
objective:a1-arrival:2.tr: Voss çok hızlı konuşuyor. Ondan tekrar söylemesini iste.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-1.de: Dein Zug ist da. Auf Bahnsteig sieben.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-1.en: Your train is here. On platform seven.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-2.de: Die Tauben sind heute vor dir da.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-2.en: The pigeons got here before you today.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-3.de: Ich habe sechs Bahnsteige. Jeden Morgen sechs.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-3.en: I have six platforms. Six every morning.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-3.tr: Altı peronum var. Her sabah altı.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-4.de: Aber du stehst auf Bahnsteig sieben.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-4.en: But you are standing on platform seven.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-5.de: Die Laterne ist an. Jetzt ist er da.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-5.en: The lantern is on. Now the platform is here.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-5.tr: Fener yanıyor. Şimdi peron da burada.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-6.de: Deine Fahrkarte, bitte. Ich brauche deinen Namen.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-6.en: Your ticket, please. I need your name.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-7.de: Hier steht dein Name. Unten steht E.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-7.en: Your name is here. There is an E below.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-7.tr: Burada adın yazıyor. Altta E var.

dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-8.de: Dein Name geht weg. Die Fahrkarte bleibt.
dialogue:a1-arrival-intro-8.en: Your name is fading. The ticket remains.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-request.de: Ihre Fahrkarte ist nicht gültig. Abgeben, bitte.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-request.en: Your ticket is not valid. Hand it over, please.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-request.tr: Biletiniz geçerli değil. Teslim edin, lütfen.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-request:variant.de: Ihre Fahrkarte, bitte. Sie ist nicht gültig.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-request:variant.en: Your ticket, please. It is not valid.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-0.de: Gern. Ihre Fahrkarte ist nicht gültig.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-1.de: Bahnsteig sieben steht nicht im Plan.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-2.de: Der Zug ist hier. Wir sind hier.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-2.en: The train is here. We are here.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-3.de: Der Plan ist richtig. Ihre Fahrkarte nicht.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-3.en: The timetable is correct. Your ticket is not.

dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-4.de: Dann bleibt die Fahrkarte bei mir.
dialogue:a1-arrival-gate-4.en: Then the ticket stays with me.

dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-0.de: Wer bekommt Ihre Fahrkarte: Otto oder ich?
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-0.en: Who gets your ticket: Otto or me?
dialogue:a1-arrival-choice-0.tr: Biletinizi kim alacak: Otto mu, ben mi?

choice:a1-arrival:report.de: Hier, bitte. Die Fahrkarte ist für Sie.

dialogue:a1-arrival-complete-0.de: Marta hat einen Kaffee für dich.
dialogue:a1-arrival-complete-0.tr: Marta'nın senin için bir kahvesi var.

dialogue:a1-arrival-report-0.de: Danke. Ihre Fahrkarte bleibt bei mir.
dialogue:a1-arrival-report-0.en: Thank you. Your ticket stays with me.

dialogue:a1-arrival-report-1.de: Lesen Sie mein Buch. Alles steht hier.
dialogue:a1-arrival-report-1.en: Read my ledger. Everything is here.
dialogue:a1-arrival-report-1.tr: Defterimi okuyun. Her şey burada yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-arrival-report-2.de: Deine Fahrkarte ist weg. Sein Buch bleibt.
dialogue:a1-arrival-report-2.en: Your ticket is gone. His ledger stays.

dialogue:a1-arrival-protect-1.de: Hier ist deine Fahrkarte. Voss ist weg.
dialogue:a1-arrival-protect-1.en: Here is your ticket. Voss is gone.

dialogue:a1-arrival-protect-2.de: Mein Schlüssel öffnet Bahnsteig sieben. Für dich.
dialogue:a1-arrival-protect-2.en: My key opens platform seven. For you.
dialogue:a1-arrival-protect-2.tr: Anahtarım yedinci peronu açar. Senin için.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-1.de: Er schreibt die Tauben auf. Jeden Tag.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-1.en: He writes down the pigeons. Every day.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-2.de: Auch Tauben brauchen eine Fahrkarte, Herr Otto.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-2.en: Even pigeons need a ticket, Mr Otto.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-who-voss-2.tr: Güvercinlerin de bilete ihtiyacı var, Otto Bey.

topic:a1-arrival:why-seven.de: Warum gibt es Bahnsteig sieben nicht?

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-why-seven-0.de: Im Plan stehen nur sechs Bahnsteige.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-pigeons-0.de: Sie fahren jeden Tag ohne Fahrkarte mit.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-pigeons-0.en: They ride along every day without a ticket.

dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-pigeons-1.de: Heute schlafen sie. So geht es auch.
dialogue:a1-arrival-topic-pigeons-1.en: Today they are sleeping. That works too.

evidence:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticebo.de: Bahnsteige eins bis sechs. Kein Bahnsteig sieben.
evidence:a1-arrival:lindenhafen-noticebo.tr: Birden altıya kadar peronlar. Yedinci peron yok.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-0.de: Komm! Der Wasserkocher sagt deinen Namen.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-0.en: Come in! The kettle is saying your name.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-1.de: Das Wetter weiß er. Namen sind neu.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-1.en: It knows the weather. Names are new.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-2.de: Du bist {name}? Dann bleib bei mir.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-2.en: You are {name}? Then stay with me.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-2.tr: Sen {name} misin? O zaman yanımda kal.

dialogue:a1-cafe-reported-ticket.de: Voss hat deine Fahrkarte? Komm zu mir.
dialogue:a1-cafe-reported-ticket.en: Voss has your ticket? Come over here.

dialogue:a1-cafe-otto-key.de: Du hast Ottos Schlüssel? Dann bleibst du!
dialogue:a1-cafe-otto-key.en: You have Otto’s key? Then you are staying!
dialogue:a1-cafe-otto-key.tr: Otto'nun anahtarı sende mi? O zaman kalıyorsun!

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-3.de: Gestern saß hier eine Frau. Sie war allein.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-3.en: A woman sat here yesterday. She was alone.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-3.tr: Dün burada bir kadın oturuyordu. Yalnızdı.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-4.de: Sie hat deinen Kaffee schon bezahlt.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-4.en: She has already paid for your coffee.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-5.de: Ihr Name? Den weiß ich nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-5.en: Her name? I cannot remember it any more.

dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-6.de: Die Rechnung wartet auch. Noch kein Kaffee.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-6.en: The receipt is waiting too. No coffee yet.
dialogue:a1-cafe-intro-6.tr: Fiş de bekliyor. Kahve henüz yok.

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-request.de: Was möchtest du trinken? Kaffee oder Tee?
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-request.en: What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-request.tr: Ne içmek istersin? Kahve mi, çay mı?

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-request:variant:0.de: Die Frau hat bezahlt. Was möchtest du?

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-0.de: Dein Kaffee. Jetzt ist die Rechnung fertig.
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-0.en: Your coffee. Now the receipt is complete.

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-1.de: Sie hat gestern bezahlt. Hier steht morgen.
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-1.en: She paid yesterday. This says tomorrow.

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-2.de: Hier ist das Siegel von Voss.

dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-3.de: Er war gestern nicht hier. Nur sie.
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-3.en: He was not here yesterday. Only her.
dialogue:a1-cafe-gate-3.tr: Dün burada değildi. Yalnızca o kadın vardı.

dialogue:a1-cafe-reported-again.de: Voss hat schon deine Fahrkarte. Das auch?
dialogue:a1-cafe-reported-again.en: Voss already has your ticket. This too?
dialogue:a1-cafe-reported-again.tr: Biletin zaten Voss'ta. Bu da mı?

dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-0.de: Bekommt Voss die Rechnung oder nimmst du sie?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-0.en: Will Voss get the receipt, or will you take it?
dialogue:a1-cafe-choice-0.tr: Fişi Voss mu alacak, sen mi?

choice:a1-cafe:report.de: Voss bekommt die Rechnung. Sie hat sein Siegel.
choice:a1-cafe:report.en: Voss gets the receipt with his seal.
choice:a1-cafe:report.tr: Fişi Voss alacak. Üzerinde onun mührü var.

dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-0.de: Fritz hat Äpfel mit dem Siegel.
dialogue:a1-cafe-complete-0.tr: Fritz’in elmalarında da bu mühür var.

dialogue:a1-cafe-report-0.de: Gut. Voss bekommt sie. Ich schreibe alles ab.
dialogue:a1-cafe-report-0.en: All right. Voss gets it. I will copy everything.
dialogue:a1-cafe-report-0.tr: Peki. Voss alacak. Ben hepsini kopyalıyorum.

dialogue:a1-cafe-report-1.de: Jetzt sagt der Wasserkocher deinen Namen nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-cafe-report-1.en: Now the kettle has stopped saying your name.

dialogue:a1-cafe-protect-0.de: Nimm sie mit. Hier steht dein Name.
dialogue:a1-cafe-protect-0.en: Take it with you. Your name is here.

dialogue:a1-cafe-protect-1.de: Hör zu! Der Wasserkocher sagt wieder {name}.
dialogue:a1-cafe-protect-1.en: Listen! The kettle is saying {name} again.

topic:a1-cafe:kettle.de: Woher weiß der Wasserkocher das Wetter?

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-kettle-0.de: Er war schon vor dem Café hier.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-kettle-1.de: Am Dienstag sagt er alles falsch.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-kettle-1.tr: Salı günleri her şeyi yanlış söylüyor.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-0.de: Sie war müde. Ihre Hände waren schwarz.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-0.en: She was tired. Her hands were black.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-1.de: Ihr Tee steht noch da. Sie kommt nicht.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-1.en: Her tea is still there. She is not coming.

dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-2.de: Sie kannte deinen Namen. Sie kannte mich.
dialogue:a1-cafe-topic-woman-2.en: She knew your name. She knew me.

gate-prompt:a1-market.en: Tell Fritz how many apples you need.
gate-prompt:a1-market.tr: Fritz'e kaç elmaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

objective:a1-market:0.en: Meet Fritz at his market stall

objective:a1-market:1.en: Read the apple crate and look at the garden
objective:a1-market:1.tr: Elma kasasını oku ve bahçeye bak

objective:a1-market:2.en: Tell Fritz how many apples you need.
objective:a1-market:2.tr: Fritz'e kaç elmaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

objective:a1-market:3.en: Decide what gets written down first

dialogue:a1-market-intro-0.de: Hallo! Meine Suppe ist fertig. Aber wer fehlt?
dialogue:a1-market-intro-0.en: Hello! My soup is ready. But who is missing?
dialogue:a1-market-intro-0.tr: Merhaba! Çorbam hazır. Ama kim eksik?

dialogue:a1-market-intro-1.de: Am Freitag essen wir zusammen. Hier isst keiner allein.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-1.en: We eat together on Fridays. Nobody eats alone here.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-1.tr: Cuma günleri birlikte yemek yeriz. Burada kimse yalnız yemez.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-2.de: Im Gästebuch stehen alle Namen. Hier fehlt einer.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-2.en: Every name is in the guest book. One is missing here.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-2.tr: Konuk defterinde herkesin adı var. Burada bir ad eksik.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-3.de: Nummer sieben braucht Äpfel. Einen? Zwei? Ich weiß es nicht.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-3.en: Number seven needs apples. One? Two? I cannot remember.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-3.tr: Yedi numaranın elmaya ihtiyacı var. Bir mi? İki mi? Hatırlamıyorum.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-4.de: Ich kenne sie. Sie sitzt immer hier.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-4.en: I know her. She always sits here.

dialogue:a1-market-voss-book.de: Nummer sieben steht hier. Das Buch ist richtig.
dialogue:a1-market-voss-book.en: Number seven is here. The ledger is correct.
dialogue:a1-market-voss-book.tr: Yedi numara burada yazıyor. Defter doğru.

dialogue:a1-market-marta-receipt.de: Du hast Martas Rechnung? Ihr Name steht noch da.
dialogue:a1-market-marta-receipt.en: You have Marta’s receipt? Her name is still there.
dialogue:a1-market-marta-receipt.tr: Marta'nın fişi sende mi? Adı hâlâ orada.

dialogue:a1-market-intro-5.de: Die Äpfel haben Nummern und das Siegel von Voss.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-5.en: The apples have numbers and Voss’s seal.
dialogue:a1-market-intro-5.tr: Elmaların üzerinde numaralar ve Voss'un mührü var.

dialogue:a1-market-gate-request.de: Du möchtest Äpfel. Einen oder zwei? Was brauchst du?
dialogue:a1-market-gate-request.en: You want apples. One or two? What do you need?
dialogue:a1-market-gate-request.tr: Elma istiyorsun. Bir mi, iki mi? Ne lazım?

dialogue:a1-market-gate-request:variant:.de: Brauchst du einen Apfel oder zwei?
dialogue:a1-market-gate-request:variant:.en: Do you need one apple or two?
dialogue:a1-market-gate-request:variant:.tr: Bir elma mı lazım, iki mi?

dialogue:a1-market-gate-0.de: Zwei! Jetzt weiß ich es wieder. Zwei Äpfel!
dialogue:a1-market-gate-0.en: Two! Now I remember. Two apples!

dialogue:a1-market-gate-1.de: Frau Berg kauft jeden Freitag zwei Äpfel. Für die Suppe.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-1.en: Mrs Berg buys two apples every Friday. For the soup.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-1.tr: Berg Hanım her cuma iki elma alır. Çorba için.

dialogue:a1-market-gate-2.de: Ihr Haus hat einen Garten. Die Nummer ist sieben.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-2.en: Her house has a garden. The number is seven.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-2.tr: Evinin bir bahçesi var. Numarası yedi.

dialogue:a1-market-gate-3.de: Frau Berg. Ihr Name fehlt. Ihr Platz ist frei.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-3.en: Mrs Berg. Her name is missing. Her seat is empty.
dialogue:a1-market-gate-3.tr: Berg Hanım. Adı yok. Yeri boş.

dialogue:a1-market-otto-names.de: Otto kennt das. Auf Fahrkarten gehen Namen auch weg.
dialogue:a1-market-otto-names.en: Otto knows this. Names disappear from tickets too.
dialogue:a1-market-otto-names.tr: Otto bunu biliyor. Biletlerdeki adlar da siliniyor.

dialogue:a1-market-choice-0.de: Schreiben wir ihren Namen auf oder geben Voss die Nummer?
dialogue:a1-market-choice-0.en: Will we write down her name, or give Voss her number?
dialogue:a1-market-choice-0.tr: Adını mı yazalım, numarasını mı Voss'a verelim?

choice:a1-market:protect.de: Ich schreibe ihren Namen ins Gästebuch.

dialogue:a1-market-complete-0.de: Otto wartet am Bahnhof. Dort fehlt auch ein Name.
dialogue:a1-market-complete-0.en: Otto is waiting at the station. A name is missing there too.
dialogue:a1-market-complete-0.tr: Otto istasyonda bekliyor. Orada da bir ad eksik.

dialogue:a1-market-report-0.de: Voss bekommt die Nummer. Ich kenne ihren Namen wieder.
dialogue:a1-market-report-0.en: Voss gets the number. I remember her name again.
dialogue:a1-market-report-0.tr: Numarayı Voss alacak. Ben artık adını hatırlıyorum.

dialogue:a1-market-report-1.de: Die Suppe ist fertig. Ihr Platz bleibt frei.
dialogue:a1-market-report-1.en: The soup is ready. Her seat stays empty.
dialogue:a1-market-report-1.tr: Çorba hazır. Onun yeri boş kalıyor.

dialogue:a1-market-protect-0.de: Frau Berg steht wieder hier. Ihr Platz bleibt für sie.
dialogue:a1-market-protect-0.en: Mrs Berg is here again. We will keep her seat for her.
dialogue:a1-market-protect-0.tr: Berg Hanım yine burada yazıyor. Yerini ona saklayacağız.

dialogue:a1-market-protect-1.de: Hier ist ihre Adresse. Nimm das Papier mit.
dialogue:a1-market-protect-1.en: Here is her address. Take the paper with you.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-numbers-0.de: Voss bringt die Nummern. Immer am Montag.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-numbers-1.de: Ich esse nur den Apfel. Die Nummer schmeckt nicht.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-numbers-1.tr: Ben sadece elmayı yerim. Numaranın tadı yok.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-0.de: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil. Hier haben alle einen Tisch.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-0.en: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil. Everyone has a table here.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-0.tr: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil. Burada herkesin bir masası var.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-1.de: Die Tauben von Otto auch. Sie bezahlen nie.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-guests-1.tr: Otto'nun güvercinleri de. Onlar hiç para ödemez.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-0.de: Ohne Apfel schmeckt sie nicht. Komm, du bekommst auch Suppe.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-0.en: It does not taste right without apple. Come, have some soup.
dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-0.tr: Elmasız güzel olmuyor. Gel, sana da çorba var.

dialogue:a1-market-topic-soup-1.de: Meine Mutter sagt das. Und meine Oma auch.

evidence:a1-market:lindenhafen-market-cr.de: Zwei Äpfel. Nummer 7. Ein Siegel. Kein Name.
evidence:a1-market:lindenhafen-market-cr.tr: İki elma. Numara 7. Bir mühür. İsim yok.

evidence:a1-market:lindenhafen-garden.de: Ein Garten. Am Haus: Nummer 7. Kein Name.
evidence:a1-market:lindenhafen-garden.tr: Bir bahçe. Evde: 7 numara. İsim yok.

gate-prompt:a1-station.en: Ask the man on the bench if the seat is free.
gate-prompt:a1-station.tr: Banktaki adama yerin boş olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a1-station:0.en: Find Otto by the departure board

objective:a1-station:1.en: Read the sign on platform seven

objective:a1-station:2.en: Ask the man on the bench if the seat is free.
objective:a1-station:2.tr: Banktaki adama yerin boş olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a1-station:3.en: Decide between the sign and the old door
objective:a1-station:3.tr: Tabela ile eski kapı arasında seçim yap

dialogue:a1-station-intro-0.de: Heute Morgen waren es sechs Bahnsteige. Jetzt sind es sieben.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-0.en: There were six platforms this morning. Now there are seven.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-0.tr: Bu sabah altı peron vardı. Şimdi yedi var.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-1.de: Hier steht nur W. Mehr steht hier nicht.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-1.en: There is only a W here. Nothing more.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-1.tr: Burada yalnızca W yazıyor. Başka bir şey yok.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-2.de: Ich kenne die Stadt seit zwanzig Jahren. Ihr Name fehlt.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-2.en: I have known the town for twenty years. Its name is missing.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-2.tr: Bu kasabayı yirmi yıldır tanıyorum. Adı yok.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-3.de: Der Mann kommt jeden Abend. Er sitzt immer dort.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-3.en: That man comes every evening. He always sits there.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-3.tr: O adam her akşam geliyor. Hep orada oturuyor.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-4.de: Seine alte Maschine spricht. Er hört nur zu.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-4.en: His old machine speaks. He only listens.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-4.tr: Eski makinesi konuşuyor. O yalnızca dinliyor.

dialogue:a1-station-key-in-hand.de: Dein Schlüssel öffnet die Tür. Dort liegt mein Buch.
dialogue:a1-station-key-in-hand.en: Your key opens the door. My register is in there.

dialogue:a1-station-ledger-in-hand.de: Du hast sein Buch. Dort steht nichts über die Bank.
dialogue:a1-station-ledger-in-hand.en: You have his ledger. There is nothing about the bench in it.
dialogue:a1-station-ledger-in-hand.tr: Onun defteri sende. Bank hakkında hiçbir şey yazmıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-berg-back.de: Frau Berg steht wieder im Gästebuch. Ihr Platz bleibt frei.
dialogue:a1-station-berg-back.en: Mrs Berg is in the guest book again. Her seat stays empty.
dialogue:a1-station-berg-back.tr: Berg Hanım yine konuk defterinde. Yeri boş kalıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-intro-5.de: Er sitzt allein. Seine Jacke liegt auf dem freien Platz.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-5.en: He is sitting alone. His coat is on the free seat.
dialogue:a1-station-intro-5.tr: Yalnız oturuyor. Ceketi boş yerde duruyor.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-request.de: Da ist ein Platz. Voss sieht zu dir.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-request.en: There is a seat. Voss looks towards you.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-request.tr: Orada bir yer var. Voss sana doğru bakıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-request:variant.de: Da ist ein Platz. Voss sieht dich an.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-request:variant.en: There is a seat. Voss is looking at you.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-request:variant.tr: Orada bir yer var. Voss sana bakıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-0.de: Ja. Der Platz ist frei. Bitte.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-1.de: Sie sind von Bahnsteig sieben. Der Platz ist frei.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-1.en: You are from platform seven. The seat is free.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-2.de: Einen Moment, bitte. Jetzt spricht sie.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-2.en: One moment, please. She is speaking now.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-2.tr: Bir dakika, lütfen. Şimdi o konuşuyor.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-3.en: A woman. She is speaking quietly.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-4.de: Ist da jemand? Ich bin noch hier.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-4.en: Is anyone there? I am still here.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-4.tr: Orada biri var mı? Ben hâlâ buradayım.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-5.de: Ich höre sie jeden Abend. Sie hört mich nicht.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-5.en: I hear her every evening. She cannot hear me.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-5.tr: Onu her akşam duyuyorum. O beni duymuyor.

dialogue:a1-station-gate-6.de: Das gehört nicht in mein Buch.
dialogue:a1-station-gate-6.en: This does not belong in my ledger.

dialogue:a1-station-ticket-blank.de: Ihre Fahrkarte ist bei mir. Ihr Name ist jetzt weg.
dialogue:a1-station-ticket-blank.en: I have your ticket. Your name is gone now.

dialogue:a1-station-choice-0.de: Bleibt das W im Buch oder öffnen wir die Tür?
dialogue:a1-station-choice-0.en: Will the W stay in the ledger, or will we open the door?
dialogue:a1-station-choice-0.tr: W defterde mi kalacak, yoksa kapıyı mı açacağız?

choice:a1-station:report.de: Herr Voss, schreiben Sie das Schild auf.

choice:a1-station:protect.de: Ich öffne die Tür mit Ottos Schlüssel.

choice:a1-station:show-ledger.de: Herr Voss, hier ist Ihr Buch. Kommen Sie mit?
choice:a1-station:show-ledger.tr: Voss Bey, işte defteriniz. Benimle gelir misiniz?

choice:a1-station:ask-otto.de: Otto, hast du noch einen Schlüssel?
choice:a1-station:ask-otto.tr: Otto, bir anahtarın daha var mı?

dialogue:a1-station-complete-0.de: Emils Licht wartet auch hier. Emil sucht es schon.
dialogue:a1-station-complete-0.en: Emil’s light waits here too. Emil is already looking for it.
dialogue:a1-station-complete-0.tr: Emil'in ışığı da burada bekliyor. Emil onu aramaya başladı bile.

dialogue:a1-station-report-0.de: W. So steht es hier. Ich schreibe es auf.
dialogue:a1-station-report-0.en: W. That is what it says. I am writing it down.

dialogue:a1-station-report-1.de: Der Buchstabe bleibt. Der Name kommt nicht zurück.
dialogue:a1-station-report-1.en: The letter stays. The name does not come back.

dialogue:a1-station-second-key.de: Noch einen Schlüssel? Ja. Ich habe zwei.
dialogue:a1-station-second-key.tr: Bir anahtar daha mı? Evet. İki tane var.

dialogue:a1-station-voss-witness.de: Ich komme mit. Heute lese ich Ihr Buch.
dialogue:a1-station-voss-witness.en: I will come with you. Today I will read your register.
dialogue:a1-station-voss-witness.tr: Sizinle geliyorum. Bugün ben sizin defterinizi okuyacağım.

dialogue:a1-station-protect-0.de: Die Tür ist auf. Mein altes Buch ist noch da.
dialogue:a1-station-protect-0.en: The door is open. My old register is still there.
dialogue:a1-station-protect-0.tr: Kapı açık. Eski defterim hâlâ orada.

dialogue:a1-station-protect-1.de: Hundert Fahrkarten für sieben. Auf jeder steht E.
dialogue:a1-station-protect-1.en: A hundred tickets for seven. There is an E on every one.
dialogue:a1-station-protect-1.tr: Yedinci peron için yüz bilet. Her birinde E yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-0.de: Er kauft nie eine Fahrkarte. Er fährt nie.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-0.tr: Hiç bilet almaz. Hiç yolculuk etmez.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-1.de: Er sagt, er wartet nicht. Er kommt aber jeden Abend.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-1.en: He says he is not waiting. But he comes every evening.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-man-1.tr: Beklemediğini söylüyor. Ama her akşam geliyor.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-sign-0.de: Nach W… Gestern stand hier noch der Name.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-sign-1.de: Ich kenne jeden Zug. Heute fehlt mir eine Stadt.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-sign-1.en: I know every train. Today a town is missing from my memory.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-sign-1.tr: Her treni bilirim. Bugün bir kasabayı hatırlayamıyorum.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-pigeons-0.de: Auf sechs Bahnsteigen. Nie auf sieben.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-pigeons-1.de: Lindenhafen hat heute sieben. Morgen vielleicht acht.
dialogue:a1-station-topic-pigeons-1.tr: Lindenhafen'in bugün yedi peronu var. Yarın belki sekiz.

dialogue:a1-station-topic-pigeons-2.de: Die Tauben wissen es. Ich nicht.

evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-noticebo.de: Bahnsteig sieben: Nach W… Abfahrt: sechs Uhr. Dann nichts.
evidence:a1-station:lindenhafen-noticebo.tr: Yedinci peron: W… yönü. Kalkış: saat altı. Sonra hiçbir şey.

gate-prompt:a1-workshop.en: The lamp only stays with people who need it. Tell Emil you need a lamp.
gate-prompt:a1-workshop.tr: Lamba yalnızca ona ihtiyacı olanların yanında kalır. Emil'e bir lambaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

objective:a1-workshop:1.en: Read the label on the workbench

objective:a1-workshop:2.en: The lamp only stays with people who need it. Tell Emil you need a lamp.
objective:a1-workshop:2.tr: Lamba yalnızca ona ihtiyacı olanların yanında kalır. Emil'e bir lambaya ihtiyacın olduğunu söyle.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-0.de: Vorsicht! Die Lampe läuft weg. Nicht schon wieder!
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-0.en: Watch out! The lamp is running away. Not again!

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-1.de: Ich bin Emil. Ich habe sie gemacht. Sie hört nie zu.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-1.en: I am Emil. I made her. She never listens.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-1.tr: Ben Emil. Onu ben yaptım. Hiç söz dinlemiyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-2.de: Dienstags fliegt sie. Das gehört so. Meist.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-2.en: She flies on Tuesdays. That is how it works. Mostly.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-2.tr: Salı günleri uçuyor. Böyle olması gerekiyor. Çoğunlukla.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-3.de: Aber heute läuft sie weg. Von mir! Ihrem Vater!
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-3.en: But today she is running away. From me! Her father!

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-4.de: Du hast ein Problem. Sie sieht dich an. Sie weiß es.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-4.en: You have a problem. She is looking at you. She knows.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-4.tr: Bir sorunun var. Sana bakıyor. Biliyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-5.de: Abends sucht sie alte Adressen. Dort sind keine Häuser mehr.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-5.en: In the evening she looks for old addresses. The houses are gone.
dialogue:a1-workshop-intro-5.tr: Akşamları eski adresleri arıyor. Evler artık orada değil.

dialogue:a1-workshop-archive-register.de: In Ottos Buch steht E. Auf meiner Lampe steht es auch.
dialogue:a1-workshop-archive-register.en: There is an E in Otto’s register. There is one on my lamp too.
dialogue:a1-workshop-archive-register.tr: Otto'nun defterinde E yazıyor. Lambamın üzerinde de var.

dialogue:a1-workshop-voss-visit.de: Voss war hier. Sie ist sofort unter den Tisch gegangen.
dialogue:a1-workshop-voss-visit.en: Voss was here. She went straight under the table.
dialogue:a1-workshop-voss-visit.tr: Voss buradaydı. Hemen masanın altına girdi.

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-request.de: Sie wartet vor deinen Füßen. Brauchst du eine Lampe?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-request.en: She is waiting at your feet. Do you need a lamp?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-request.tr: Ayaklarının önünde bekliyor. Lambaya ihtiyacın var mı?

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-request:varian.de: Sie hört zu. Brauchst du eine Lampe?
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-request:varian.tr: Dinliyor. Bir lambaya ihtiyacın var mı?

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-0.de: Sie bleibt bei dir! Bei mir bleibt sie nie so lange.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-0.en: She is staying with you! She never stays that long with me.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-0.tr: Yanında kalıyor! Benim yanımda hiç bu kadar kalmaz.

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1.de: Jetzt ist sie hell. Und jetzt geht sie zur Post.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1.en: Now she is bright. And now she is going to the post office.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-1.tr: Şimdi parlıyor. Şimdi de postaneye gidiyor.

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-2.de: Zur Post? Dann fehlt dort eine Adresse. Komm, wir gehen mit.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-2.en: The post office? An address must be missing there. Come, let us follow.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-2.tr: Postaneye mi? O zaman orada bir adres eksik. Gel, peşinden gidelim.

dialogue:a1-workshop-receipt-glow.de: Deine Rechnung! Die Lampe macht deinen Namen wieder hell.
dialogue:a1-workshop-receipt-glow.en: Your receipt! The lamp is making your name bright again.

dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-3.de: Voss will eine Nummer. Für mich bleibt sie meine Kleine.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-3.en: Voss wants a number. To me she is still my little one.
dialogue:a1-workshop-gate-3.tr: Voss bir numara istiyor. Benim için o hâlâ benim küçüğüm.

dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-0.de: Bekommt Voss ihre Nummer oder geht meine Lampe mit dir?
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-0.en: Will Voss get her number, or will my lamp go with you?
dialogue:a1-workshop-choice-0.tr: Voss numarasını mı alacak, lambam seninle mi gelecek?

choice:a1-workshop:report.de: Voss darf sie in sein Buch schreiben.

dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-0.de: Lina wartet bei der Post. Die Lampe ist schon dort.
dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-0.en: Lina is waiting at the post office. The lamp is already there.
dialogue:a1-workshop-complete-0.tr: Lina postanede bekliyor. Lamba oraya vardı bile.

dialogue:a1-workshop-report-0.de: Lampe Nummer hundert. Voss ist zufrieden. Sie steht unter dem Tisch.
dialogue:a1-workshop-report-0.en: Lamp number one hundred. Voss is pleased. She is under the table.
dialogue:a1-workshop-report-0.tr: Yüz numaralı lamba. Voss memnun. Lamba masanın altında.

dialogue:a1-workshop-report-1.de: Sie geht zur Post. Voss geht mit. Er hat ein Formular.
dialogue:a1-workshop-report-1.en: She is going to the post office. Voss is following. He has a form.
dialogue:a1-workshop-report-1.tr: Postaneye gidiyor. Voss da gidiyor. Elinde bir form var.

dialogue:a1-workshop-protect-0.de: Bei dir funktioniert sie. Komm gut wieder, meine Kleine.
dialogue:a1-workshop-protect-0.en: She works for you. Come home safe, little one.
dialogue:a1-workshop-protect-0.tr: Seninle çalışıyor. Sağ salim dön, küçüğüm.

dialogue:a1-workshop-protect-1.de: Am Dienstag fliegt sie. Sie braucht dann deine Hand.
dialogue:a1-workshop-protect-1.en: She flies on Tuesdays. She needs your hand then.
dialogue:a1-workshop-protect-1.tr: Salı günleri uçuyor. O zaman eline ihtiyacı var.

topic:a1-workshop:tuesday.de: Was macht die Lampe am Dienstag?

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-tuesday-0.de: Sie fliegt. Einen Meter. Am Dienstag mit Regen: zwei Meter.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-tuesday-0.tr: Uçuyor. Bir metre. Yağmurlu salılarda: iki metre.

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-tuesday-1.de: Mit Regen! Ich verstehe das auch nicht. Noch nicht!

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-0.de: Ich habe sie aus einem alten Licht gemacht. Vom Bahnhof.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-0.tr: Onu eski bir ışıktan yaptım. İstasyondan.

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-origin-1.de: Von Bahnsteig sieben, glaube ich. Ich habe Otto nicht gefragt.

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-works-0.de: Sie funktioniert meist. Meine Uhr nicht. Und die Maschine für Kaffee…
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-works-0.en: She mostly works. My clock does not. And the coffee machine…
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-works-0.tr: Çoğunlukla çalışıyor. Saatim çalışmıyor. Kahve makinesi ise…

dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-works-1.de: Nein. Der Kaffee ist bei Marta besser. Gehen wir.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-works-1.en: No. Marta’s coffee is better. Let us go.
dialogue:a1-workshop-topic-works-1.tr: Hayır. Marta'nın kahvesi daha iyi. Gidelim.

evidence:a1-workshop:lindenhafen-workben.de: Lampe. Funktioniert: meist. Am Dienstag fliegt sie. Sie sucht alte Adressen.
evidence:a1-workshop:lindenhafen-workben.tr: Lamba. Çalışıyor: genelde. Salıları uçar. Eski adresleri arar.

gate-prompt:a1-lost-parcel.en: Ask Lina for the address on your parcel.

objective:a1-lost-parcel:2.en: Ask Lina for the address on your parcel.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-0.de: Du bist {name}? Gut. Hier ist dein Paket. Unterschreib bitte.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-0.en: You are {name}? Good. Here is your parcel. Please sign.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-0.tr: Sen {name} misin? Güzel. İşte paketin. İmzala, lütfen.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-1.de: Es ist von gestern. Ich bringe Post auch nach gestern.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-1.en: It is from yesterday. I deliver to yesterday too.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-1.tr: Dünden geliyor. Ben düne de posta götürürüm.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-2.de: Nur die Adresse bleibt nicht. Die Tinte geht weg.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-2.en: Only the address will not stay. The ink is fading.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-3.de: Ich lese sie. Sie geht weg. Ich lese sie wieder.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-3.en: I read it. It disappears. I read it again.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-4.de: Hier steht E. Wie auf deiner Fahrkarte. Es ist für dich.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-4.en: There is an E here. Like on your ticket. This is for you.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-4.tr: Burada E yazıyor. Biletindeki gibi. Bu senin için.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-carried-lamp.de: Deine Lampe bleibt beim Paket. Sie geht nicht mehr.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-carried-lamp.en: Your lamp is staying by the parcel. She will not move.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-carried-lamp.tr: Lamban paketin yanında duruyor. Artık gitmiyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-registered-lamp.de: Lampe Nummer hundert ist hier. Ihre Adresse fehlt noch.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-registered-lamp.en: Lamp number one hundred is here. Your address is still missing.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-registered-lamp.tr: Yüz numaralı lamba burada. Adresiniz hâlâ eksik.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-5.de: Frau Berg bekommt auch Post. Ihr Haus steht dort. Noch.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-5.en: Mrs Berg gets post too. Her house is there. Still.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-5.tr: Berg Hanım'a da posta var. Evi orada. Hâlâ.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-request.de: Das Paket ist für dich. Die Adresse fehlt. Du hast eine Frage?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-request.en: The parcel is for you. The address is missing. Do you have a question?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-request.tr: Paket senin için. Adres eksik. Sormak istediğin bir şey var mı?

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-request:var.de: Für dich. Du möchtest die Adresse wissen?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-request:var.en: For you. You want to know the address?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-request:var.tr: Senin için. Adresi mi öğrenmek istiyorsun?

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-0.de: W… A… L… D… Jetzt bleibt die Tinte. Ich kann es lesen.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-0.en: W… A… L… D… Now the ink is holding. I can read it.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-0.tr: W… A… L… D… Mürekkep artık duruyor. Okuyabiliyorum.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1.de: Waldruh. Hier steht Waldruh. Jetzt kann ich es lesen.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1.en: Waldruh. It says Waldruh here. Now I can read it.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1.tr: Waldruh. Burada Waldruh yazıyor. Artık okuyabiliyorum.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-2.de: Auf meiner Karte fehlt die Stadt. Hier fehlt sie nicht.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-2.en: The town is missing from my map. It is not missing here.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-2.tr: Kasaba haritamda yok. Ama burada var.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-3.de: Im Paket liegt ein Brief. E heißt Elise. Sie schreibt dir.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-3.en: There is a letter in the parcel. E is Elise. She is writing to you.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-3.tr: Paketin içinde bir mektup var. E, Elise demek. Sana yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-4.de: „Ich bin Elise. Ich warte in Waldruh.“
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-4.en: “I am Elise. I am waiting in Waldruh.”

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-receipt-hands.de: Hier ist schwarze Tinte. Sie bleibt an meiner Hand.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-receipt-hands.en: Here is black ink. It stays on my hand.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-receipt-hands.tr: Burada siyah mürekkep var. Elimden çıkmıyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-5.de: Frau Bergs Nummer geht weg! Ihre Post ist noch hier.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-5.en: Mrs Berg’s number is fading! Her post is still here.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-5.tr: Berg Hanım'ın numarası siliniyor! Postası hâlâ burada.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-0.de: Bekommt Voss die Adresse oder bleibt sie bei uns?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-0.en: Will Voss get the address, or will it stay between us?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-0.tr: Adresi Voss mu alacak, yoksa aramızda mı kalacak?

choice:a1-lost-parcel:report.de: Voss bekommt die Adresse. Dann steht sie im Buch von Voss.
choice:a1-lost-parcel:report.tr: Adresi Voss alsın. O zaman Voss'un defterinde yazar.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-0.de: Ihr Haus ist weg. Ich habe ihre Post noch in der Hand.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-0.en: Her house is gone. I still have her post in my hand.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-berg-kept.de: Frau Berg steht in deinem Gästebuch. Ihr Name ist noch da.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-berg-kept.en: Mrs Berg is in your guest book. Her name is still there.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-berg-kept.tr: Berg Hanım konuk defterinde yazıyor. Adı hâlâ orada.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-1.de: Bevor du uns wieder auslöschst, komm.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-1.en: Before you erase us again, come.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-2.de: Otto wartet am Zug. Im Brief steht noch ein Satz:
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-2.en: Otto is waiting by the train. There is one more sentence in the letter:
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-2.tr: Otto trenin yanında bekliyor. Mektupta bir cümle daha var:

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-report-0.de: Ich schicke Voss die Adresse. Dein Brief bleibt bei dir.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-report-0.en: I will send Voss the address. Your letter stays with you.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-report-0.tr: Adresi Voss'a gönderiyorum. Mektubun sende kalıyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-report-1.de: Waldruh steht dann auch im Buch von Voss. Und hier bei dir.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-report-1.en: Waldruh will be in Voss’s ledger too. And here, with you.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-report-1.tr: Waldruh o zaman Voss'un defterinde de yazacak. Burada, sende de.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-protect-0.de: Der Brief bleibt bei dir. Voss bekommt keine Adresse.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-protect-0.en: The letter stays with you. Voss will not get an address.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-protect-0.tr: Mektup sende kalıyor. Voss adresi alamayacak.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-protect-1.de: Er kann mich fragen. Deine Post gehört dir.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-protect-1.en: He can ask me. Your post belongs to you.

topic:a1-lost-parcel:yesterday.de: Wie bringst du Post nach gestern?

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-yesterday-.de: Ich gehe schnell. Immer nach links. Nie nach rechts.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-yesterday-.en: I walk fast. Always left. Never right.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-yesterday-.tr: Hızlı yürürüm. Hep sola. Asla sağa değil.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-yesterday-.de: Zwei Briefe kamen gestern an. Beide pünktlich. Heute kann ich warten.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-yesterday-.en: Two letters arrived yesterday. Both on time. Today I can wait.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-yesterday-.tr: Dün iki mektup ulaştı. İkisi de zamanında. Bugün bekleyebilirim.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-0.de: Ein Brief, glaube ich. Ich öffne nie ein Paket. Nie.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-0.tr: Bir mektup, sanırım. Ben asla paket açmam. Asla.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-1.de: Aber es ist schwer. Für einen Brief zu schwer.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-1.tr: Ama ağır. Bir mektup için fazla ağır.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-berg-0.de: Sie hat einen Garten. Sie kauft freitags zwei Äpfel.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-berg-0.en: She has a garden. She buys two apples on Fridays.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-berg-0.tr: Bir bahçesi var. Cuma günleri iki elma alır.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-berg-1.de: Sie bekommt jeden Tag Post. Heute kann ich sie nicht bringen.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-berg-1.en: She gets post every day. Today I cannot deliver it.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-berg-1.tr: Her gün posta alır. Bugün ona götüremiyorum.

evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-parc.de: Für {name}. Absender: E. Adresse: … Die Tinte geht weg.
evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-parc.tr: {name} için. Gönderen: E. Adres: … Mürekkep siliniyor.

gate-prompt:a2-apartment.en: Ask Inspector Voss politely whether he could please repair it.
gate-prompt:a2-apartment.tr: Müfettiş Voss'a kibarca, onu tamir edip edemeyeceğini sor.

objective:a2-apartment:0.en: Find out why Inspector Voss is inspecting the inn
objective:a2-apartment:0.tr: Müfettiş Voss'un hanı neden denetlediğini öğren

objective:a2-apartment:2.en: Ask Inspector Voss politely whether he could please repair it.
objective:a2-apartment:2.tr: Müfettiş Voss'a kibarca, onu tamir edip edemeyeceğini sor.

objective:a2-apartment:3.en: Decide whether the door stays open
objective:a2-apartment:3.tr: Kapının açık kalıp kalmayacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.de: Schnell, {name}, komm rein! Ich halte die Tür. Heute führt sie nach Waldruh.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.en: Quick, {name}, come in! I’m holding the door. Today it leads to Waldruh.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.tr: Çabuk, {name}, içeri gel! Kapıyı tutuyorum. Bugün Waldruh’a açılıyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.de: Vor fünf Minuten führte sie noch in meine Küche. Der Kaffee steht auf der anderen Seite.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.en: Five minutes ago it led into my kitchen. The coffee is still on the other side.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.tr: Beş dakika önce mutfağıma açılıyordu. Kahve hâlâ öbür tarafta.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.de: Café und Gasthaus teilen sich diese Tür. Wenn sie klemmt, komme ich an keines von beiden heran.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.en: The café and inn share this door. When it sticks, I can’t get into either.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.tr: Kafe ile han bu kapıyı paylaşıyor. Sıkışınca ikisine de giremiyorum.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.de: Guten Tag. Ich prüfe dieses Gebäude. Halten Sie bitte den Türrahmen fest.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.en: Good afternoon. I am inspecting this building. Please hold the doorframe steady.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.tr: İyi günler. Bu binayı denetliyorum. Lütfen kapının kasasını sabit tutun.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.de: Danke für die Adresse aus Lindenhafen. Sie hat mich direkt hierher geführt.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.tr: Lindenhafen'den gelen adres için teşekkür ederim. Beni doğrudan buraya getirdi.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.de: Er kam durch meine Küche. Ohne zu klopfen. Bei einem Inspektor hätte ich mehr Papier erwartet.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.en: He came through my kitchen. Without knocking. I expected more paperwork from an inspector.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.tr: Mutfağımdan girdi. Kapıyı çalmadan. Bir müfettişten daha çok evrak beklerdim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.de: In dieser Akte steht: Waldruh ist freiwillig verschwunden. Ein seltsamer Satz für ein Dorf voller Menschen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.en: This file says Waldruh vanished voluntarily. A strange sentence for a village full of people.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.tr: Bu dosyada Waldruh’un kendi isteğiyle kaybolduğu yazıyor. İnsanlarla dolu bir köy için tuhaf bir cümle.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6:variant:0.de: Laut meiner Akte wollte Waldruh verschwinden. Die Menschen hier sehen das offenbar anders.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6:variant:0.en: My file says Waldruh wanted to vanish. The people here seem to disagree.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6:variant:0.tr: Dosyama göre Waldruh kaybolmak istemiş. Buradaki insanlar belli ki farklı düşünüyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.de: Die Menschen wollen frühstücken. Für ein verschwundenes Dorf haben wir erstaunlich gute Kartoffeln.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.en: The people want breakfast. For a vanished village, we have remarkably good potatoes.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.tr: İnsanlar kahvaltı etmek istiyor. Kaybolmuş bir köy için patateslerimiz şaşırtıcı derecede iyi.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.de: Der Kühlschrank hat eine Nummer im Register. Diese Tür nicht. Deshalb darf ich den Rahmen nicht verändern.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.en: The refrigerator has a register number. This door does not. That means I cannot alter its frame.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.tr: Buzdolabının sicilde bir numarası var. Bu kapının yok. Bu yüzden kasasında değişiklik yapamam.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.de: Dann bleibt sie halb offen. Heute Morgen hat mein Ärmel in Lindenhafen festgesteckt. Ich war schon hier.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.en: Then it stays half open. This morning my sleeve got stuck in Lindenhafen. I was already here.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.tr: O zaman yarı açık kalır. Bu sabah kolum Lindenhafen’de takıldı. Ben çoktan buradaydım.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.de: Ein Antrag des Mieters erlaubt die Reparatur. Wer wohnt hinter dieser Tür, in Zimmer 7?
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.en: A request from the tenant authorizes the repair. Who lives behind this door, in Room 7?
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.tr: Kiracının başvurusu onarıma izin verir. Bu kapının arkasında, 7 numaralı odada kim kalıyor?

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-11.de: Am Brett hängt ein Mietvertrag. Dein Name steht darauf, {name}. Ich habe dir noch gar kein Zimmer angeboten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-11.en: There’s a lease on the board. It has your name, {name}. I haven’t even offered you a room.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-11.tr: Panoda bir kira sözleşmesi var. Üzerinde senin adın yazıyor, {name}. Sana daha oda bile teklif etmedim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-request-0.de: Der Vertrag nennt Sie als Mieter, {name}. Die Reparatur können also Sie beantragen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-0.en: The lease names you as the tenant, {name}. You can request the repair.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-0.tr: Sözleşmede kiracı olarak siz görünüyorsunuz, {name}. Onarım için siz başvurabilirsiniz.

dialogue:a2-apartment-request-1.de: Seit drei Monaten. Dabei bist du erst heute angekommen. Deinen Zimmerschlüssel habe ich noch nie gesehen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-1.en: For three months. Yet you only arrived today. I’ve never seen your room key before.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-1.tr: Üç aydır. Oysa daha bugün geldin. Oda anahtarını daha önce hiç görmedim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-request-2.de: Das Schloss klemmt. Mein Werkzeug liegt bereit. Mit Ihrer Bitte kann ich anfangen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-2.en: The lock is stuck. My tools are ready. If you request the repair, I can begin.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-2.tr: Kilit sıkışmış. Aletlerim hazır. Onarım talebinizle işe başlayabilirim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-0.de: Antrag angenommen. Erst der Stempel, dann die Schraube. Jetzt hält der Rahmen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-0.en: Request accepted. First the stamp, then the screw. The frame is holding now.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-0.tr: Başvuru kabul edildi. Önce mühür, sonra vida. Kasa artık sağlam duruyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-1.de: Sie geht auf! Mein Kaffee steht noch da. Niemand hat ihn angerührt. Eine Reise war noch nie so kurz.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-1.en: It opens! My coffee is still there. Nobody touched it. I’ve never had such a short journey.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-1.tr: Açılıyor! Kahvem hâlâ orada. Kimse dokunmamış. Hiç bu kadar kısa bir yolculuk yapmamıştım.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-2.de: Die Miete ist für ein Jahr bezahlt. Von Elise. Drei Monate vor Ihrer Ankunft.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-2.en: The rent is paid for a year. By Elise. Three months before your arrival.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-2.tr: Bir yıllık kira ödenmiş. Elise tarafından. Gelişinizden üç ay önce.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-3.de: Entschuldigen Sie. Ich muss das Datum vergleichen. Mein Register beginnt erst mit Ihrer Fahrkarte.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-3.en: Excuse me. I need to compare the dates. My register begins with your ticket.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-3.tr: Affedersiniz. Tarihleri karşılaştırmalıyım. Sicilim sizin biletinizle başlıyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-4.de: Er hält den Vertrag verkehrt herum. Das passiert ihm sonst nur bei meinen Speisekarten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-4.en: He’s holding the lease upside down. Usually he only does that with my menus.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-4.tr: Sözleşmeyi ters tutuyor. Bunu genelde sadece benim menülerime yapar.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.de: Durch die offene Tür kann jeder reisen. Lassen wir sie offen, oder fragen wir die Nachbarn zuerst?
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.en: An open door lets anyone travel through. Do we leave it open, or ask the neighbours first?
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.tr: Kapı açıkken herkes geçebilir. Açık mı bırakalım, yoksa önce komşulara mı soralım?

choice:a2-apartment:restore.de: Wir lassen sie offen. Lindenhafen soll Waldruh sehen.

choice:a2-apartment:consult.de: Wir fragen zuerst die Nachbarn hier.

dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.de: Fritz will hier wieder einen Tisch für alle decken. Aber er nennt keinen Tag.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.en: Fritz wants to set a table for everyone here again. But he won’t name a day.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.tr: Fritz burada yeniden herkes için sofra kurmak istiyor. Ama bir gün söylemiyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-1.de: Wenn jemand nach dem Termin fragt, rührt er die Suppe. Auch wenn der Topf leer ist.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-1.en: Whenever anyone asks for a date, he stirs the soup. Even when the pot is empty.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-1.tr: Biri tarih sorunca çorbayı karıştırıyor. Tencere boşken bile.

dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-0.de: Ich stelle einen Stuhl in die Tür. Wer heute nach Waldruh will, findet einen Weg.
dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-0.en: I’ll wedge a chair in the doorway. Anyone coming to Waldruh today will find a way in.
dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-0.tr: Kapının arasına bir sandalye koyacağım. Bugün Waldruh’a gelmek isteyenler içeri girebilecek.

dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-1.de: Post für Waldruh! Drei Briefe, alle von gestern. Ich bin durch die Küche gekommen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-1.tr: Waldruh'a posta! Üç mektup, hepsi dünden. Mutfaktan geçtim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-0.de: Ich hänge einen Zettel auf: Erst klopfen. Niemand soll die Tür vor seinem Haus plötzlich offen finden.
dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-0.en: I’ll put up a note: knock first. Nobody should find a door outside their home opened without warning.
dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-0.tr: Bir not asacağım: Önce kapıyı çalın. Kimse evinin önündeki kapıyı habersizce açık bulmasın.

dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-1.de: Ich habe Klopfen gehört. Gibt es eine Versammlung? Ich habe Suppe dabei.
dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-1.tr: Kapı çalındığını duydum. Toplantı mı var? Yanımda çorba getirdim.

topic:a2-apartment:one-door.de: Warum haben dein Café und das Gasthaus dieselbe Tür?
topic:a2-apartment:one-door.tr: Kafenle han neden aynı kapıyı paylaşıyor?

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.de: Meine Oma sagt, früher war das ein Haus. Die Strecke lief mitten durch den Flur.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.tr: Ninem eskiden burasının tek bir ev olduğunu söylüyor. Hat tam koridorun ortasından geçiyormuş.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.de: Dann war die Strecke weg. Und das Haus stand auf einmal in zwei Städten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.tr: Sonra hat ortadan kalktı. Ve ev birdenbire iki şehirde birden duruyordu.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.de: Die Tür ist geblieben. Türen sind treuer als Akten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.tr: Kapı kaldı. Kapılar dosyalardan daha vefalıdır.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-kettle-0.de: Regen für morgen. Und ab und zu einen Namen, den ich nicht kenne.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-kettle-0.tr: Yarın için yağmur. Arada bir de tanımadığım bir isim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-kettle-1.de: Ich schreibe die Namen auf. Ein Wasserkocher lügt nicht. Er übertreibt nur.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-kettle-1.tr: İsimleri not ediyorum. Çaydanlık yalan söylemez. Sadece abartır.

topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.de: Wie lange bleiben Sie in Waldruh, Herr Voss?
topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.tr: Waldruh'da ne kadar kalacaksınız, Voss Bey?

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.de: Bis die Akte und das Dorf dasselbe sagen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.tr: Dosya ile köy aynı şeyi söyleyene kadar.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.de: Bis dahin bleibt die Akte gültig. Sonst müsste ich jede Entscheidung meines Amts neu prüfen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.en: Until then, the file stands. Otherwise I would have to reconsider every decision my office has made.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.tr: O zamana kadar dosya geçerli. Aksi hâlde dairemin verdiği her kararı yeniden incelemem gerekir.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-2.de: Ich mache ihm ein Bett. Er hat schon gefragt, ob das Kissen registriert ist.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-2.tr: Ona bir yatak hazırlayacağım. Yastığın kayıtlı olup olmadığını şimdiden sordu.

evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.de: Mietvertrag für Zimmer 7. Mieter: {name}. Die Miete für ein Jahr hat Elise im Voraus bezahlt. Zwei Adressen: Gasthaus Waldruh und Martas Café in Lindenhafen. Eine Tür. Gültig seit drei Monaten. Am Papier hängt ein schwerer Schlüssel mit einer kleinen Laterne.
evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.tr: 7 numaralı oda için kira sözleşmesi. Kiracı: {name}. Bir yıllık kirayı Elise peşin ödemiş. İki adres: Waldruh Hanı ve Marta'nın Lindenhafen'deki kafesi. Tek bir kapı. Üç aydır geçerli. Kâğıtta, küçük bir fenerle süslü ağır bir anahtar asılı.

gate-prompt:a2-evening-plans.en: Ask Fritz whether he has time tomorrow.
gate-prompt:a2-evening-plans.tr: Fritz'e yarın vakti olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-evening-plans:0.en: Listen to the argument about Fritz’s festival

objective:a2-evening-plans:1.en: Read the Circle’s calendar at the herb garden

objective:a2-evening-plans:2.en: Ask Fritz whether he has time tomorrow.
objective:a2-evening-plans:2.tr: Fritz'e yarın vakti olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-evening-plans:3.en: Decide whether to send the signal or hear the Circle first
objective:a2-evening-plans:3.tr: Önce sinyali mi göndereceğinize, yoksa topluluğu mu dinleyeceğinize karar ver

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.de: Heute Abend senden wir das Signal. Wenn Lindenhafen unser Licht sieht, wissen sie, dass Waldruh noch da ist.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.en: Tonight we send the signal. When Lindenhafen sees our light, they’ll know Waldruh is still here.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.tr: Bu akşam sinyali gönderiyoruz. Lindenhafen ışığımızı görünce Waldruh’un hâlâ burada olduğunu anlayacak.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.de: Und was sagen wir denen, die hier wohnen? Sie erfahren wieder zuletzt, was mit ihrem Dorf passiert.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.en: And what do we tell the people living here? Once again, they’re last to hear what happens to their village.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.tr: Peki burada yaşayanlara ne diyeceğiz? Köylerine ne olduğunu yine en son onlar öğrenecek.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.de: Ah, {name}. Nimm einen Teller. Solange alle essen, streitet niemand. Meistens.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.en: Ah, {name}. Take a bowl. While everyone’s eating, nobody argues. Usually.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.tr: Ah, {name}. Bir kâse al. Herkes yemek yerken kimse tartışmaz. Genelde.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.de: Fritz hat schon die Teller gezählt. Jetzt fehlen ihm nur noch Gäste. Und ein Termin.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.en: Fritz has counted the bowls. All he needs now are guests. And a date.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.tr: Fritz kâseleri saydı bile. Şimdi sadece misafirler eksik. Bir de tarih.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.de: Ich bin Greta. Hier wächst unser Essen. Der Farn überwacht alles. Bitte Abstand halten, er niest.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.en: I’m Greta. We grow our food here. The fern supervises everything. Keep your distance; he sneezes.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.tr: Ben Greta. Yiyeceklerimizi burada yetiştiriyoruz. Eğreltiotu her şeyi denetliyor. Lütfen fazla yaklaşma, hapşırıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.de: Wir gehören zum Kreis der Ungeschriebenen. Manche von uns stehen in keiner Akte. Alle sitzen an Fritz’ Tisch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.en: We belong to the Unwritten Circle. Some of us appear in no file. All of us sit at Fritz’s table.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.tr: Yazılmamışlar Topluluğu’ndanız. Bazılarımız hiçbir dosyada yer almıyor. Hepimiz Fritz’in sofrasında oturuyoruz.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.de: Niemand hat uns gefragt, bevor die Strecke geschlossen wurde. Im Papier steht trotzdem: freiwillig.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.en: Nobody asked us before the route closed. The paper still says: voluntary.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.tr: Hat kapatılmadan önce bize kimse sormadı. Buna rağmen evrakta “gönüllü” yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6:varian.de: Die Strecke wurde geschlossen. Uns hat niemand gefragt. Auf dem Papier steht, wir wollten es so.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6:varian.en: The route was closed. Nobody asked us. The paper says we wanted it.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6:varian.tr: Hat kapatıldı. Bize kimse sormadı. Evrakta bunu istediğimiz yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.de: Wir haben an diesem Abend hier gegessen. Um sechs. Ich holte noch Brot. Danach war die Strecke weg.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.en: We ate here that evening. At six. I went to fetch more bread. Afterwards the route was gone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.tr: O akşam burada yemek yedik. Saat altıda. Biraz daha ekmek getirmeye gittim. Sonra hat yok olmuştu.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.de: Seitdem deckt er jeden Abend den Tisch. Aber er lädt niemanden zu einer festen Zeit ein.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.en: Ever since, he sets the table every evening. But he never invites anyone for a definite time.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.tr: O günden beri her akşam sofra kuruyor. Ama kimseyi belli bir saate davet etmiyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.de: Frau Berg hat geschrieben. Ihr Haus ist weg. Ihren Namen hat sie behalten. Für sie decken wir mit.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.en: Frau Berg wrote to us. Her house is gone. She still has her name. We’ll set a place for her.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.tr: Frau Berg bize yazdı. Evi yok olmuş. Adı hâlâ var. Onun için de bir yer hazırlayacağız.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-10.de: Die Frau aus Lindenhafen, mit den Äpfeln. Ich will ihr schreiben. Ihr Name fällt mir nicht mehr ein.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-10.en: The woman from Lindenhafen, with the apples. I want to write to her. I can’t remember her name.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-10.tr: Lindenhafen’deki kadın, elmaları olan. Ona yazmak istiyorum. Adını hatırlayamıyorum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-11.de: Unser Kalender hängt am Kräutergarten. Er ist … sehr ehrlich.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-11.tr: Takvimimiz ot bahçesinde asılı. Kendisi… çok dürüsttür.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-0.de: Meine Briefe müssen heute los. Sonst erreicht die Einladung niemanden rechtzeitig.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-0.en: My letters have to leave today. Otherwise the invitations won’t reach anyone in time.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-0.tr: Mektuplarım bugün yola çıkmalı. Yoksa davetler kimseye zamanında ulaşmaz.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-1.de: Morgen können alle kommen. Fritz, du entscheidest, ob dein Tisch auf uns wartet.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-1.en: Everyone can come tomorrow. Fritz, it’s your decision whether your table will be waiting for us.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-1.tr: Yarın herkes gelebilir. Fritz, sofranın bizi bekleyip beklemeyeceğine sen karar vereceksin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-2.de: Morgen steht noch nichts in meinem Kalender. Aber wenn ich einlade, verspreche ich, dass wir uns wiedersehen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-2.en: There’s nothing in my calendar tomorrow. But if I invite everyone, I’m promising we’ll see each other again.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-2.tr: Yarın takvimimde hiçbir şey yok. Ama davet edersem yeniden görüşeceğimize söz vermiş olurum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-0.de: Morgen? Ja. Für dich habe ich Zeit. Und für die anderen auch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-0.en: Tomorrow? Yes. I have time for you. And for everyone else too.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-0.tr: Yarın mı? Evet. Sana zamanım var. Diğerlerine de.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-1.de: Halb sieben. Nicht wieder um sechs. Ich will die Uhr hören, ohne den leeren Bahnhof zu sehen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-1.en: Half past six. Six is too much. I want to hear the clock without seeing the empty station.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-1.tr: Altı buçuk. Yine altı olmasın. Saati duyduğumda boş istasyonu görmek istemiyorum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-2.de: Ich schreibe es auf. Morgen, halb sieben. Lina, diesmal geht die Einladung an jeden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-2.en: I’ll write it down. Tomorrow, half past six. Lina, this time the invitation goes to everyone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-2.tr: Yazıyorum. Yarın, altı buçuk. Lina, bu kez davet herkese gidecek.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-3.de: Wir kommen, Fritz. Du musst den Tisch nicht allein decken.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-3.en: We’ll be there, Fritz. You don’t have to set the table alone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-3.tr: Geleceğiz, Fritz. Sofrayı tek başına kurmak zorunda değilsin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-4.de: Gut. Aber Lindenhafen wartet auf ein Lebenszeichen. Das Licht können wir noch heute schicken.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-4.en: Good. But Lindenhafen is waiting for a sign we’re still here. We can send the light tonight.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-4.tr: Güzel. Ama Lindenhafen hâlâ burada olduğumuza dair bir işaret bekliyor. Işığı bu akşam gönderebiliriz.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.de: Senden wir heute ein Lebenszeichen, oder wartet das Signal, bis alle hier ihre Wünsche gesagt haben?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.en: Do we send a sign tonight, or wait until everyone here has said what they want?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.tr: Bu akşam bir işaret gönderelim mi, yoksa buradaki herkes isteğini söyleyene kadar sinyali bekletelim mi?

choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.de: Wir senden heute Licht. Lindenhafen soll wissen, dass ihr noch hier seid.
choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.en: We send the light tonight. Lindenhafen should know you’re still here.
choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.tr: Bu akşam ışık gönderelim. Lindenhafen hâlâ burada olduğunuzu bilmeli.

choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.de: Wir hören zuerst den Kreis. Diesmal warten wir auf ihre Antworten.
choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.en: We hear the Circle first. This time we wait for their answers.
choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.tr: Önce topluluğu dinleyelim. Bu kez cevaplarını bekleyelim.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.de: Morgen, halb sieben. Ich stelle auch die kleinen Teller hin. Die Kinder sollen uns finden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.en: Tomorrow, half past six. I’ll put out the little bowls too. The children should find us here.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.tr: Yarın, altı buçuk. Küçük kâseleri de koyacağım. Çocuklar bizi burada bulabilsin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.de: Ach, und Otto sucht dich. Er hat unter dem Bahnhof einen alten Fahrplan gefunden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.tr: Ha, bir de Otto seni arıyor. İstasyonun altında eski bir tarife bulmuş.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-0.de: Laternen an! Eins, zwei, drei … Das Licht geht über den Wald.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-0.tr: Fenerler yansın! Bir, iki, üç… Işık ormanın üzerinden geçiyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-1.de: Lindenhafen antwortet! Drei kurze Lichter. Marta kennt unser Zeichen noch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-1.en: Lindenhafen is answering! Three short flashes. Marta still remembers our signal.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-1.tr: Lindenhafen cevap veriyor! Üç kısa ışık. Marta işaretimizi hâlâ hatırlıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-0.de: Ich schreibe die Wünsche auf. Der Farn bekommt die letzte Zeile. Er hat schon genug Aufmerksamkeit.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-0.en: I’ll write down everyone’s wishes. The fern gets the last line. He’s had enough attention already.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-0.tr: Herkesin isteğini yazacağım. Eğreltiotu son satırı alacak. Zaten yeterince ilgi gördü.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-1.de: Am Waldrand kommen Leute mit Stühlen. Sie haben ihre Namen mitgebracht. Heute bleiben sie nicht draußen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-1.en: People are coming from the forest with chairs. They’ve brought their names. Today they won’t be left outside.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-1.tr: Ormanın kenarından sandalyeleriyle insanlar geliyor. Adlarını da getirmişler. Bugün dışarıda kalmayacaklar.

topic:a2-evening-plans:circle.de: Wer gehört zum Kreis der Ungeschriebenen?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.de: Alle, deren Namen einmal falsch oder gar nicht aufgeschrieben wurden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.tr: Adı bir zamanlar yanlış yazılan ya da hiç yazılmayan herkes.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.de: Wir erinnern uns gegenseitig. Jeden Morgen sagen wir unsere Namen laut. Das hilft.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.tr: Birbirimizi hatırlıyoruz. Her sabah isimlerimizi yüksek sesle söylüyoruz. İşe yarıyor.

topic:a2-evening-plans:fern.de: Warum ist dein Farn unter Beobachtung?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-0.de: Er hat letzte Woche auf einen Stempel vom Messingamt geniest. Seitdem ist der Stempel grün.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-0.tr: Geçen hafta Pirinç Dairesi'nin bir damgasına hapşırdı. O günden beri damga yeşil.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-1.de: Ich beobachte ihn. Er beobachtet das Amt. Das ist fair.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-1.tr: Ben onu gözlüyorum. O da Daire'yi gözlüyor. Bu adil.

topic:a2-evening-plans:fritz-here.de: Warum bist du in Waldruh, Fritz?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.de: Meine Äpfel rollen seit einer Woche alle nach Norden. Ich bin hinterhergelaufen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.tr: Elmalarım bir haftadır hep kuzeye yuvarlanıyor. Peşlerinden geldim.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.de: Und hier gibt es Kürbisse, so groß wie Koffer. Ich bleibe ein bisschen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.tr: Burada da bavul büyüklüğünde balkabakları var. Biraz kalacağım.

evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.de: Kalender des Kreises. Laternenfest: dreimal verschoben. Neuer Termin: offen. Daneben hängt die Einladung zum letzten gemeinsamen Abendessen. Alle Namen sind verblasst. Nur „18 Uhr“ ist noch lesbar. Fritz hat einen Topf daneben gezeichnet.
evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.en: The Circle’s calendar. Lantern festival: postponed three times. New date: undecided. Beside it hangs the invitation to the last shared supper. Every name has faded. Only “6 p.m.” is legible. Fritz drew a cooking pot beside it.
evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.tr: Topluluğun takvimi. Fener şenliği üç kez ertelenmiş. Yeni tarih belirsiz. Yanında son ortak akşam yemeğinin daveti asılı. Bütün adlar solmuş. Yalnızca “18.00” okunabiliyor. Fritz yanına bir tencere çizmiş.

gate-prompt:a2-rail-trip.en: Tell Otto that you missed your connection.

objective:a2-rail-trip:0.en: Try to catch the evening connection with Otto
objective:a2-rail-trip:0.tr: Otto ile akşam aktarmasına yetişmeye çalış

objective:a2-rail-trip:1.en: Read what is under the new paint on the route sign
objective:a2-rail-trip:1.tr: Hat tabelasındaki yeni boyanın altında ne yazdığını oku

objective:a2-rail-trip:2.en: Tell Otto that you missed your connection.

objective:a2-rail-trip:3.en: Decide what happens to the missing minute
objective:a2-rail-trip:3.tr: Kayıp dakikaya ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.de: Zum Bahnsteig, {name}! Hörst du das Pfeifen? Heute bekommen wir diesen Zug zu sehen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.en: To the platform, {name}! Hear that whistle? Today we’ll see this train for ourselves.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.tr: Perona, {name}! Düdüğü duyuyor musun? Bugün bu treni kendi gözlerimizle göreceğiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.de: Der alte Fahrplan nennt einen Anschluss nach Nebelstadt. Abfahrt: 18:00. Die Fahrkarte sagt dasselbe.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.en: The old timetable lists a connection to Nebelstadt. Departure: 18:00. The ticket says the same.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.tr: Eski tarifede Nebelstadt’a bir aktarma treni var. Kalkış: 18.00. Bilette de aynı saat yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.de: Die Bahnhofsuhr steht noch vor sechs. Er müsste warten. Die Türen sind schon geschlossen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.en: The station clock hasn’t reached six. It should be waiting. Its doors are already closed.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.tr: İstasyon saatinde daha altı olmadı. Beklemesi gerekirdi. Kapıları çoktan kapanmış.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-3.de: Ihre Fahrkarte, bitte. Diese Kontrolle kann ich nicht überspringen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-3.en: Your ticket, please. I cannot skip this inspection.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-4.de: Herr Voss, Sie sehen doch, dass er losfährt!
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-4.en: Mr Voss, you can see it’s leaving!

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.de: Gültig. Abfahrt 18:00. Sie sind rechtzeitig hier. Der Zug müsste ...
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.en: Valid. Departure: 18:00. You are here on time. The train should ...

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.de: Weg. Wir standen direkt vor der Tür. Er ist ohne uns gefahren.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.en: Gone. We were right outside the door. It left without us.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.tr: Gitti. Tam kapısının önündeydik. Bizi almadan gitti.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.de: Dein Register aus Lindenhafen hat dieselben leeren Zeilen. Heute tragen wir ein, wer hier stand.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.en: Your Lindenhafen register has the same blank lines. Today we’ll record who was standing here.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.tr: Lindenhafen sicilinde de aynı boş satırlar var. Bugün burada kimin durduğunu kaydedeceğiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.de: Mein Schlüssel öffnet jede Bahnhofstür. Einen Zug hält er leider nicht an.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.en: My key opens every station door. Sadly, it won’t stop a train.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.tr: Anahtarım istasyonun bütün kapılarını açar. Ne yazık ki treni durdurmaz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.de: Meine Akte sagt, hier fährt kein Zug. Ich habe eben einen gesehen. Beides schreibe ich auf.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.en: My file says no train runs here. I just saw one. I will write down both.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.tr: Dosyam burada tren çalışmadığını söylüyor. Az önce bir tane gördüm. İkisini de yazacağım.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-10.de: Seit Jahren wartet hier niemand. Heute hat der Zug einen Fahrgast zurückgelassen. Das lässt sich prüfen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-10.en: Nobody has waited here for years. Today the train left a passenger behind. We can investigate that.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-10.tr: Yıllardır burada kimse beklemiyor. Bugün tren bir yolcuyu geride bıraktı. Bunu araştırabiliriz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-11.de: Am alten Schild blättert die Farbe ab. Darunter steht noch das Ziel. Die Uhrzeit fehlt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-11.en: The paint is peeling off the old sign. The destination is underneath. The time is missing.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-11.tr: Eski tabelanın boyası dökülüyor. Altında hâlâ varış yeri yazıyor. Saat eksik.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-0.de: Ich öffne den Schalter. Deine Fahrkarte bleibt hier, neben der Bahnhofsuhr.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-0.en: I’ll open the ticket window. Your ticket stays here beside the station clock.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-0.tr: Gişeyi açıyorum. Biletin burada, istasyon saatinin yanında kalacak.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-1.de: Ich bestätige, dass Sie vor der Abfahrt hier waren. Für den Bericht brauche ich Ihre Aussage.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-1.en: I confirm that you were here before departure. I need your account for the report.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-1.tr: Kalkıştan önce burada olduğunuzu doğruluyorum. Rapor için ifadenize ihtiyacım var.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-2.de: Bahnhof Waldruh, Schalter eins. Die Fahrkarte ist gültig. Warum konntest du nicht weiterfahren?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-2.en: Waldruh station, window one. The ticket is valid. Why couldn’t you continue your journey?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-2.tr: Waldruh istasyonu, bir numaralı gişe. Bilet geçerli. Yolculuğuna neden devam edemedin?

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-0.de: Verpasster Anschluss. Ich vergleiche deine Fahrkarte mit der Uhr. Sie hat bei der Abfahrt angehalten.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-0.en: Missed connection. I’ll compare your ticket with the clock. It stopped as the train departed.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-0.tr: Kaçırılan aktarma. Biletini saatle karşılaştırıyorum. Tren kalkarken saat durmuş.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-1.de: 17:59. Auf deiner Fahrkarte steht 18:00. Wer nach der Fahrkarte kommt, sieht nur noch den leeren Bahnsteig.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-1.en: 17:59. Your ticket says 18:00. Anyone following the ticket arrives to find an empty platform.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-1.tr: 17.59. Biletinde 18.00 yazıyor. Biletteki saate göre gelenler yalnızca boş peronu görüyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-2.de: Auf dem Schild steht jetzt: von innen geschlossen, mit einem Hüterschlüssel. Die frühe Abfahrt hält Zeugen fern.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-2.en: The sign now says: closed from inside, with a keeper’s key. Leaving early keeps witnesses away.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-2.tr: Tabelada artık bir koruyucu anahtarıyla içeriden kapatıldığı yazıyor. Erken kalkış, tanıkların gelmesini engelliyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-3.de: Von innen geschlossen. Das fehlt in meiner Akte. Auch Ihre rechtzeitige Ankunft fehlt dort.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-3.en: Closed from inside. My file omits that. It also omits your arrival on time.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-3.tr: İçeriden kapatılmış. Bu, dosyamda yok. Zamanında gelişiniz de yok.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-4.de: Dieses Pfeifen kenne ich. Es ist auf meiner Aufnahme. Abends höre ich einen Zug, den es angeblich nicht gibt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-4.en: I know that whistle. It’s on my recording. Every evening I hear a train that supposedly doesn’t exist.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-4.tr: Bu düdüğü tanıyorum. Kaydımda da var. Her akşam var olmadığı söylenen bir treni dinliyorum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-5.de: Ich kann die Bahnhofsuhr angleichen. Dann finden die Fahrgäste morgen ihren Anschluss.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-5.en: I can adjust the station clock. Tomorrow the passengers will be able to catch their connection.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-5.tr: İstasyon saatini ayarlayabilirim. Böylece yolcular yarın aktarma trenine yetişir.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-6.de: Aber der Fahrplan verändert sich mit ihr. Die falsche Zeit bleibt nur, solange wir sie nicht korrigieren.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-6.en: But the timetable changes with it. The false time stays visible only until we correct it.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-6.tr: Ama tarife de saatle birlikte değişir. Yanlış saat, ancak biz düzeltmediğimiz sürece görünür kalır.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.de: Gleichen wir die Uhr für die Fahrgäste an, oder lassen wir den Fehler stehen, bis weitere Zeugen kommen?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.en: Do we adjust the clock for passengers, or leave the error visible until more witnesses arrive?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.tr: Yolcular için saati ayarlayalım mı, yoksa başka tanıklar gelene kadar hatayı görünür mü bırakalım?

choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.de: Wir gleichen die Uhr an. Morgen soll niemand mehr hier zurückbleiben.
choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.en: We adjust the clock. Tomorrow nobody should be left behind here.
choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.tr: Saati ayarlayalım. Yarın kimse burada geride kalmasın.

choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.de: Wir sichern die falsche Zeit. Andere sollen den Fehler selbst sehen.
choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.en: We preserve the false time. Others should see the error for themselves.
choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.tr: Yanlış saati koruyalım. Başkaları da hatayı kendi gözleriyle görsün.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.de: Ein Hüterschlüssel schließt keine gewöhnliche Tür. Nimm deinen Schlüssel mit. Wir müssen wissen, was er kann.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.en: A keeper’s key doesn’t close an ordinary door. Bring your key. We need to know what it can do.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.tr: Bir koruyucu anahtarı sıradan bir kapıyı kapatmaz. Anahtarını getir. Neler yapabildiğini öğrenmeliyiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.de: Emils Werkzeuge waren eine Nacht lang weg. Danach lag ein Dankesbrief daneben. Vielleicht hängt beides zusammen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.en: Emil’s tools vanished for a night. Afterwards a thank-you note appeared beside them. Perhaps the two are connected.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.tr: Emil’in aletleri bir geceliğine kaybolmuş. Sonra yanlarında bir teşekkür notu belirmiş. Belki ikisi bağlantılıdır.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-0.de: Eine Minute vor. Die Uhr läuft wieder. Die Tauben sind empört; ihr Abendplan stimmt nicht mehr.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-0.en: One minute forward. The clock is running again. The pigeons are furious; their evening schedule is ruined.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-0.tr: Bir dakika ileri. Saat yeniden çalışıyor. Güvercinler öfkeli; akşam programları bozuldu.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-1.de: Nebelstadt, 18:00. Das Ziel bleibt auf der Anzeige. Morgen warten hier Menschen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-1.en: Nebelstadt, 18:00. The destination stays on the board. Tomorrow people will be waiting here.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-1.tr: Nebelstadt, 18.00. Varış yeri panoda kalıyor. Yarın burada insanlar bekleyecek.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-0.de: Ich schreibe beide Zeiten ab. Eine Kopie bleibt am Schalter. Jeder kann sie vergleichen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-0.en: I’ll copy both times. One copy stays at the window. Anyone can compare them.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-0.tr: İki saati de yazacağım. Bir nüsha gişede kalacak. Herkes karşılaştırabilecek.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-1.de: Ich nehme die zweite Kopie. Morgen stehen hier Leute, die man nicht mehr aus dem Bericht streichen kann.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-1.en: I’ll take the second copy. Tomorrow there’ll be people here who can no longer be left out of the report.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-1.tr: İkinci nüshayı ben alıyorum. Yarın burada, rapordan artık çıkarılamayacak insanlar duracak.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.de: Ein Zug kann pünktlich sein und trotzdem niemanden mitnehmen. Seit heute traue ich auch der Fahrkarte nicht.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.en: A train can be punctual and still take nobody aboard. As of today, I don’t trust the ticket either.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.tr: Bir tren dakik olabilir ama yine de kimseyi almayabilir. Bugünden sonra bilete de güvenmiyorum.
